articles.title: Ny bankkollaps i USA – största på två år
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Ny bankkollaps i USA – största på två år
articles.body_text: FDIC har beslutat att stänga krisbanken United Fidelity. Arkivbild. Ny bankkollaps i USA – största på två år Amerikanska myndigheter har stängt ned den regionala banken United Fidelity, vilket innebär den största bankkollapsen i USA på två år. FDIC, den amerikanska statens bolag som ansvarar för insättningsgarantier, meddelar att First Citizens har tagit över Indiana-baserade United Fidelitys insättningar och tillgångar. Enligt FDIC kommer bankstängningen att kosta insättningsgarantifonden över 1,8 miljarder dollar, motsvarande runt 18,8 miljarder kronor. Det gör det till den största bankkollapsen sedan First Republic stängdes i april 2024. I slutet av september hade United Fidelity tillgångar på cirka 5,9 miljarder dollar och insättningar på 5,4 miljarder dollar, enligt FDIC. Flera regionala banker föll under 2023–2024, då krisen sänkte bland annat First Republic, Silicon Valley och Signature.

articles.title: Bedömare: Lägre löneökningar väntar
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Bedömare: Lägre löneökningar väntar
articles.body_text: Facken inom industrin kräver 3,9 procent i lönepåslag i ett ettårigt avtal, meddelade man i början av november. Arkivbild. Löneökningarna för över tre miljoner svenskar ser ut att bli lägre än tidigare år. Det spår bedömare inför vinterns stora lönerörelse, med anledning av att fackens utgångskrav är sänkta. Det talar för att löneavtalen också växlar ner lite grann, säger Susanne Spector på Danske Bank. Den uppgörelse som slutligen nås mellan de stora facken inom industrin och arbetsgivarna brukar kallas för ”märket”. Det har i många år fungerat som ett riktmärke för hela den svenska arbetsmarknaden. Industrifacken kräver 3,9 procent i lönepåslag i kommande avtalsrörelse, och historiskt har utfallet ofta landat på omkring 70–80 procent av det ursprungliga kravet. I den förra lönerörelsen krävde facken från början 4,2 procent och landade till slut i ett tvåårigt avtal på 6,4 procent, eller 3,2 procent per år. Det kan tolkas som att man ser framför sig en liten nedväxling av lönerna jämfört med förra avtalsrörelsen, i spåren av den mycket höga inflationen, säger Danske Banks chefsekonom Susanne Spector. Även Swedbank och Nordea ser en lägre löneökningstakt framför sig. Det är också vad arbetsgivarna krävt. Jämfört med senast är konjunkturläget i Sverige betydligt bättre. Trots en ganska god omvärldskonjunktur pressas lönerna i Europa. Vi ser att lönerna tydligt har växlat ner nere på kontinenten. Flera faktorer spelar in när ett avtal ska förhandlas fram: konjunktur, arbetsmarknad och internationell konkurrens är några av parametrarna. Tittar man på plussidan så är sysselsättningen i Sverige på rekordnivåer. Vi har en bra konjunktur, och arbetslösheten faller, säger Nordeas chefsanalytiker Torbjörn Isaksson.

articles.title: Försäljningen ökar under novemberrean
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Försäljningen ökar under novemberrean
articles.body_text: Reklam för kommande Black Friday-rea. Arkivbild. Konsumtionen under årets Black Friday-rea ökar. Men under själva fredagen krymper försäljningen, enligt nya siffror. Omsättningen under fredagen – Black Friday – backar med drygt 4 procent jämfört med förra året samtidigt som drygt 8 procent färre köp gjordes, uppger prisjämförelsesajten Prisjakt och Svea Bank. Under veckan – Black Week – ligger dock omsättningen på samma nivå som förra året. Och utslaget på hela reamånaden – Black Month – ökar omsättningen med 7,2 procent och antalet transaktioner med 3,4 procent. ”För handeln blir det därför allt mer relevant att se till hela reaperioden, snarare än att bara fokusera på en enskild försäljningsdag”, säger Magdalena Caesar vid Svea Bank i ett pressmeddelande.

articles.title: Sverige satsar på vindkraft i Ukraina
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Sverige satsar på vindkraft i Ukraina
articles.body_text: På bara några timmar fick Ukrainas nationella polis in över 2000 rapporter om bombhot. Arkivbild på huvudstaden Kiev. Sverige ställer upp med motsvarande drygt 200 miljoner kronor för ny vindkraft i Ukraina. Projektet är ett led i att ”minska beroendet av fossila bränslen och göra energisystemet mindre sårbart”, skriver statliga svenska Swedfund. I Swedfunds pressmeddelande beskrivs satsningen som ett lån till att bygga och driva en vindkraftspark på 190 megawatt i nordvästra Ukraina. Satsningen görs av ukrainska Okko, som startade som mackkedja på 90-talet men nu investerar i förnybar energi. Rysslands invasionskrig riktas ofta mot elnät och elproduktion i Ukraina. Tidigare har Ukraina satsat hårt på atomreaktorer, men det största kärnkraftverket i Zaporizjzja är nu ockuperat av Ryssland och avstängt. Men vindkraften har fortsatt byggas ut under kriget, och framhålls som svårare att attackera eller erövra i och med att turbiner och övrig infrastruktur är så utspritt.

articles.title: Uppåt på Wall Street – Anthropic rusade
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Uppåt på Wall Street – Anthropic rusade
articles.body_text: Handlarna på Wall Street ser kurserna rusa. Arkivbild. New York-börserna avslutade fredagshandeln på plus efter en turbulent vecka. Anthropic rusade och handlas återigen över förra veckans teckningskurs. Tekniktunga Nasdaqs kompositindex avslutade på plus 2,3 procent, medan breda S&P 500 och Dow Jones industriindex stängde upp 1,6 respektive 1,2 procent. AI-bolaget Anthropic, som i förra veckan börsintroducerades för 83 dollar per aktie, rusade 10,8 procent. Aktien kostar nu 91,76 dollar. Nvidia, med Jensen Huang som återinsattes som vd i måndags, vände en betydande nedgång i den tidiga fredagshandeln till plus 0,9 procent. It-jättarna Meta och Amazon klättrade 3,1 respektive 4,0 procent. USA-börserna hade halvdag på fredagen, dagen efter högtiden thanksgiving.

articles.title: Publicistiska grunden för journalistik på TV4
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4?
articles.body_text: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4? 9 januari 2024 ・ Uppdaterad: 15 augusti 2025 TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning ska vara i ögonhöjd med tittarna. Vi vill vara nära, personliga och inkluderande. För alla i hela Sverige. Vi ska vara trovärdiga och relevanta. Vi testar nya visuella former och utvecklar det rörliga berättandet. Vi är både snabba, och fördjupande. Vi ger plats för både humor och allvar. Vi påverkar och berör. Vi avslöjar maktmissbruk, och värnar pressfrihet och yttrandefrihet. Vi producerar Nyhetsmorgon, Nyhetsdagen, Efter fem och kvällsnyheter. Vi nyhetsrapporterar på tv4.se och fördjupar i kortdokumentärerna Nyheterna Story. Vår mångfaldigt prisbelönta redaktion Kalla Fakta granskar makt och missförhållanden. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning sker ur ett riksperspektiv, med hela Sverige och världen som bevakningsområde. Vi har 17 rikskorrar på sex orter i Sverige. De finns i Luleå, Umeå, Östersund, Skövde, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi bevakar världen via utrikesreportrar, korrar och stringers. Vår journalistik vilar på respekt för alla människors lika värde, oavsett politisk åskådning, religion eller sexuell läggning. Det innebär att vi låter många röster komma till tals, även de som bär åsikter som inte nödvändigtvis delas av medarbetarna på redaktionen eller TV4. Men det kan också innebära att vi tar bort artikelkommentarer som kränker, eller till exempel avstår gäster i direktsändning där vi bedömer att risken är stor för missbruk av öppenheten. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik är oberoende och obunden. Den står fri från politiska partier, organisationer, och näringsliv. Vi har ingen ledarsida eller politisk färg. Innehållet på våra plattformar bedöms och värderas av redaktörer, producenter och av ansvarig utgivare före publicering. Vi följer grundlagen och skyddar våra källor när de önskar anonymitet. Om vi refererar uppgifter från andra medier redovisar vi vilka medier eller andra informationskällor det handlar om. Annars berättar vi hur vi själva tagit reda på informationen, dock alltid med största respekt för källskydd.

articles.title: Bortglömda fiskar
articles.summary: Teatrar och konserthus lockar allt oftare med olika sidoevenemang. Teater Västernorrland har musikquiz, Folkoperan sänder poddar från sin foajé och på Göteborgsoperan kan man höra föredrag eller vara med och dansa. De uppsluppna tillställningarna, före och efter konserter och föreställningar, lockar också en ny sorts publik. En av Östersjöfestivalens mest omtalade programpunkter, förutom musiken i Berwaldhallen, har varit “Bortglömda fiskar” - en oväntad kulinarisk träff med Kålrotsakademin och provsmakning av “svensk sushi”. “Gensvaret från publiken är enormt. Man vill bli överraskad”, konstaterar Emma Nyberg, exekutiv producent på Berwaldhallen. Och på frågan om vad nors och näbbgädda har att göra i ett konserthus kommer det självklara svaret snabbt: “Att äta gott och att lyssna på klassisk musik hör ihop, båda skärper och öppnar våra sinnen.”

articles.body_text: At least seven students have been killed and 99 others have been injured following an explosion near a school in Afghanistan, an official has said. The incident happened on Saturday morning in the Anderseir area of Asadabad, the capital of Kunar province, a spokesperson for the Taliban government's interior ministry said. Posting on X, Abdul Mateen Qani said that according to initial investigations, the blast was caused by "negligence and carelessness" at an explosives depot belonging to nearby mining companies. An investigation into the incident was ongoing, he added.

articles.title: Bronson Reed: Australian WWE star dies aged 38
articles.summary: Tributes have flooded in for the 38-year-old Australian who is survived by his pregnant wife, Paige, their daughter.
articles.body_text: Professional wrestler Bronson Reed has died aged 38, World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) has announced. The company said the wrestler, whose real name is Jermaine Haley, died on Friday due to medical complications but did not give further details. Paying tribute, WWE added: "Jermaine was a larger-than-life figure in WWE, but more importantly, he was a phenomenal person, a devoted family man, and a beloved colleague." They also offered condolences to the Australian's family, including his pregnant wife, Paige, and their daughter. WWE has been contacted for further comment. Haley was honoured at the WWE event at Akins Ford Arena in Athens, Georgia on Friday. The show began with a 10-bell salute for Haley and in his match, Canadian wrestler Kevin Owens wore an armband that read "Bronson" and addressed the crowd. "I knew for a fact, beyond performing in this ring, he loved his family more than anything so tonight if there is anything to take away from a tragedy like that - it's take care of each other and love each other... Forgive each other," Owens said. "Bronson, for me, we were lucky to have you and you will be extremely missed." WWE greats posted tributes online including the retired 16-time world champion Ric Flair, who wrote: "another soldier in our business that left us way too early!" WWE Hall of Famer Diamond Dallas Page said "I was deeply saddened to read about the passing of Bronson Reed. I couldn't help but think of Eddie. Such a shame. My heart goes out to his friends & family. RIP brother." WWE wrestler Eddie Guerrero - known as Latino Heat - died of heart failure at age 38 in 2005.

articles.title: Two staff killed in Israeli strike on Gaza medical clinic, MSF says
articles.summary: The Israeli military says it targeted "Hamas terrorists" in the strike which has been condemned by the World Health Organization.
articles.body_text: Two workers for the medical charity Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) have been killed in an Israeli strike in Gaza, according to the organisation. MSF said the strike was a direct hit on one of the charity's clinics, the location of which was known by the Israeli military. In a statement, the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) said the two people were Hamas operatives "acting as security guards at a clinic operated by MSF". The IDF added the strike was "not directed at a hospital" and caused no damage to medical infrastructure. The head of the World Health Organization (WHO) said that attacks on health facilities and health workers in Gaza were "outrageous and unacceptable". In a post on X, Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus wrote: "Those risking their lives to save others must be protected, not attacked." In its statement, MSF - which is also known as Doctors Without Borders - said that the two workers who were killed were watchmen, and added that the strike brought the number of its colleagues killed in Gaza to 17. The organisation said it was "devastated and outraged" and added: "​Our premises were clearly marked with MSF logos, and their location had been communicated to and was known by the Israeli military." In its own post on X, the IDF said that the two men, who they named as Ahmed Sufyan Muhammad Ali Abu Hasira and Moaz Yousef Alitsbach, were "terrorists in Hamas' military wing". The Israeli military added it was another example of Hamas "embedding itself within international organizations". It said that "precautionary measures were taken to minimize harm to civilians" before the strike on Gaza City, adding the men had "advanced plans to carry out attacks against Israeli civilians & IDF troops". Witnesses told the BBC the two men were sitting at the clinic entrance when an Israeli drone descended and fired a missile. Video footage from the scene of the strike showed a small crater beside a plastic chair, with bloodstains and limited damage in a courtyard behind the medical clinic.

articles.title: Eight killed in Peruvian military helicopter crash on rescue mission
articles.summary: The pilot was the sole survivor of the crash during a rescue mission in a remote area known for drug trafficking.
articles.body_text: Eight military personnel have been killed in a helicopter crash in a remote area of Peru known for growing and trafficking drugs. Authorities say the aircraft came down near the town of Sanabamba during a mission to evacuate an army patrol in the valley of the Apurimac, Ene, and Mantaro rivers, known by its Spanish acronym VRAEM. Often referred to as 'Cocaine Valley', the area is Peru's largest coca-growing valley where gangs and the remnants of the former Shining Path rebel group operate. The Peruvian ministry of defence said the pilot was the sole survivor of the crash, the cause of which is still unknown. In its statement, the ministry said "search and rescue operations located the aircraft and the nine military personnel who were on board". It named the pilot as Enzo Espinoza Roque and said he was evacuated to Lima to "receive specialised medical treatment". The aircraft was reported missing on Thursday night after rescuing three army personnel. No further information was shared about why the group needed to be rescued, but it was confirmed that they were among those who were killed in the crash. Joint Command of the Peruvian Armed Forces posted a tribute online extending "deepest condolences to the family members, friends, and comrades-in-arms of the members of our VRAEM Special Command who lost their lives while carrying out a military mission. May God keep them in His glory". In February, a MI-17 helicopter crashed in southern Peru in February killing all 15 on board. Peru, along with Colombia, is one of the world's largest producers of coca leaves and cocaine , according to the United Nations.

articles.title: Turkish officials 'destroyed' pro-opposition TV channel, owner tells BBC
articles.summary: The headquarters of Halk TV were raided last month, the latest in a series of crackdowns on news sources deemed critical of the government.
articles.body_text: Turkish authorities have "destroyed" one of the country's most-watched news channels, its London-based owner has told the BBC. Speaking to the BBC's Newshour, Cafer Mahiroğlu said that nine people connected to Halk TV were arrested this week on charges including money laundering, bribery and spreading misleading information. Mahiroğlu said that several of his family members were among those arrested when the pro-opposition channel was taken into government control last month, adding that the allegations against him and Halk TV are "completely wrong". The Istanbul Chief Public Prosecutor' Office said that two former news anchors of the channel were among the most recent group of people detained. In a statement, prosecutors accused the anchors of producing "false reports" in exchange for money. Authorities have also issued an arrest warrant for the channel's news coordinator Kürşad Oğuz who is "abroad", the statement said, without specifying where. Mahiroğlu told the BBC that he could be sent to prison if he tried to return to Turkey. "[The government] wants to be in control of the whole media... I'm more worried about my country and my democracy than my channel," he said. The headquarters of Halk TV was raided by Turkish authorities last month , halting the channel's live broadcasts, the latest in a series of crackdowns on news sources deemed to be critical of Turkish President Tayyip Erdoğan and his administration. The government subsequently appointed a new administrator to run the channel. Erdoğan's government controls much of the country's media, which ranks among the worst globally for press freedom , though the government insists that it does not detain media workers for carrying out journalistic activities. However, the president has scaled up a crackdown on dissent since his narrow victory in the 2023 presidential election.

articles.title: 'Poison seller' Kenneth Law apologises in court to the families of his victims
articles.summary: The Canadian man, who pleaded guilty to 14 counts of aiding and abetting suicide earlier this year, said he was remorseful for his actions.
articles.body_text: The Canadian man who sold toxic chemicals through online suicide forums in 40 countries apologised in court to the families of the victims, saying he deeply regrets his actions and will never repeat them. Kenneth Law made the remarks on Friday during a sentencing hearing where prosecutors asked a judge to give him a 25-year prison term. The 61-year-old pleaded guilty in May to 14 counts of aiding the suicide deaths of 14 people in Ontario, Canada, though he has admitted to causing the deaths of dozens of victims in England and Wales. He will not face charges in the UK or over any British deaths under a plea deal which saw Canadian authorities withdraw more serious charges of murder. During Friday's sentencing hearing in an Ontario court, prosecutors stressed that many of his victims were young and struggling with mental distress. If Law receives the prosecution's recommended sentence, he would serve just under 20 years in prison, after accounting for credit for time served since his May 2023 arrest. As she sought to make her case in court on Friday, Crown Attorney Kathleen Doherty described Law as a predator taking advantage of "vulnerable people". "What they needed was help. But what they found was Mr Law and his products for death," Doherty said. She also said Law's motives were financial. "If people could pay, he sold it to them. There's no discussion or inquiries or anything going on whereby Mr Law would have any ability to appreciate the circumstances of the individual he was dealing with," she said. Law's defence lawyer, Matthew Gourlay, countered those claims, arguing that his client was not responsible for any of their battles with mental illness.. "Each of these incidents is its own unique tragedy," Gourlay said. "Mr Law may be a common denominator between them, but Mr Law was not the cause of the struggles and hardships that caused all these victims to seek out his products in the first place."

articles.title: Spanish PM and rivals rally supporters in final pitch for votes
articles.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez wants to defy the polls, and his main rivals accuse him of not telling the truth and of "betrayal".
articles.body_text: Spain's main party leaders have held their final rallies ahead of Sunday's election, with Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez saying he is confident of defying the polls. "I cannot imagine us losing," he said, posing for selfies with supporters in red T-shirts and accusing conservative rival Alberto Núñez Feijóo of planning a coalition with the far right. Feijóo's People's Party (PP) is narrowly ahead in the polls, and in the final hours of the campaign he travelled first to Barcelona and then Seville, promising voters a new political era of "truth, decency and good governance". He accused Sánchez of evading questions on key issues like corruption, rail disasters, immigration and the national debt. The Socialist leader heads one of Europe's few left-wing governments, and with the French presidential elections five months away, there is a real chance that two of the continent's biggest economies could move to the right in quick succession. Almost 39 million people have a vote in Spain and while commentators expect a high turnout, most polls have suggested a close finish. Under Spanish electoral law, no polls have been published since Monday. "This time, yes, we're going to do it," Feijóo told PP supporters, in a nod to his failure to form a government three years ago despite winning most seats. If he gets to form a government this time, it will be with the support of anti-immigration party Vox, led by Santiago Abascal, whose final rally took place in front of thousands of people in a bull-ring in Valencia on Spain's east coast. The venue was filled with Spanish flags and green Vox banners, and one of the biggest cheers of the night came when the secretary general of the party called for "less burka and less halal". Ignacio Garriga said he was not acting out of hatred but love for the homeland. A small section of the crowd could be heard chanting "Viva Franco" in reference to the dictator, whose death in 1975 heralded the start of Spain's transition to democracy. A number of first-time voters at the rally said they were supporting Vox because of its policies on immigration.

articles.title: Paul Mackenzie: Kenyan doomsday cult leader convicted over further 123 deaths
articles.summary: Paul Mackenzie is found guilty of killing his followers, weeks after being jailed for the mass murder of children.
articles.body_text: A court in Kenya has convicted the leader of a doomsday Christian cult of the manslaughter of 123 of his followers. Paul Mackenzie was found guilty in Mombasa of ordering his followers, all adults, to fast to death in Shakahola forest near the coast between January 2021 and September 2023. Earlier this month Mackenzie was jailed for 200 years for murdering 191 people, all but one of them children, in the same mass killing. Mackenzie had pleaded not guilty to manslaughter and one of his lawyers said he would appeal against the conviction after sentencing, Reuters news agency reports. Warning: This article contains details which some people might find distressing. The court also convicted 29 others including Mackenzie's wife, Rhoda Mumbua Maweu, of their part in the manslaughter. Sixty defendants were acquitted. The Director of Public Prosecutions indicated that an appeal would be launched against their acquittal. The self-styled pastor was arrested in 2023 after the discovery of more than 400 bodies in shallow graves in the Shakahola forest, near the Indian Ocean coast. The court found Mackenzie had "systematically persuaded his followers to fast until they died", Kenya's Office of The Director of Public Prosecutions said in a statement on Friday's verdict, which it described as "the final conviction" in the cases against him. "Children were to go first, then women and then men, with Mackenzie himself meant to die last," the office said. The prosecution argued that Mackenzie and his accomplices had acted together as part of a suicide pact to fast to death in order to "meet Jesus". Witnesses testified that he had preached that education, medicine and ornaments were sinful.

articles.title: 'We couldn't give up that easily': Marching bands scramble to cover costs after Thanksgiving parade rearranged
articles.summary: Stormy weather in New York City prompted organisers to push back the Macy's parade by two days - leaving some musicians stuck.
articles.body_text: Since New York City officials postponed the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade, a precaution ahead of a storm that brought heavy rain, wind and flooding, hundreds of touring performers who traveled from across the US to perform were thrust into chaos. "It was jarring," said Ryan Demkovich, director of a Texas high school marching band. After learning the news, he had to scramble to make new arrangements for over 500 people. Demkovich and his Pearland High School band made the quick decision to launch a fundraiser, reaching $350,000 (£267,000) in just a few hours. Still, some performers reportedly had to skip the parade, a televised, traditional Thanksgiving event - now rescheduled for Saturday. On Wednesday afternoon, a day before the event, organisers announced the postponement, in part due to concerns around the parade's giant balloons in strong winds. The balloons, inflated on Wednesday, were then temporarily deflated - along with the spirits of those who journeyed to the city to watch the action. The move represented the first time the event had been postponed in its 100-year history, although it was suspended altogether during World War II. Each year, a number of marching bands travel from across the country, from high schools and colleges, to perform at the event. This is considered a huge opportunity, as the parade is watched by millions in person and on TV. Demkovich described an emotional and exhausting experience, first learning that the parade would be postponed while watching a Broadway performance of Wicked with his band. "My initial thought was like, 'Oh, crap. We're not going to be able to go'," he said. "Where are we going to be able to get all the money for this?" The delay meant unexpected expenses of additional nights in a hotel - and meals - for hundreds of people in the middle of New York City during the holidays.

articles.title: Canada's top court largely upholds Quebec ban on religious symbols for public servants
articles.summary: The law faced legal challenges from a range of groups, including female Muslim, Sikh and Catholic teachers, who argued it violated their fundamental rights.
articles.body_text: Canada's top court has largely upheld a Quebec law banning public sector workers from wearing religious symbols, including the hijab and the cross. The law, known as Bill 21, faced legal challenges from a range of groups, including female Muslim, Sikh and Catholic teachers, who argued it violated their fundamental rights. Quebec passed the law in 2019 under a unique fixture of Canada's constitution called the "notwithstanding clause" - a legal loophole that allows governments to override certain rights, like freedom of religion. The Supreme Court's decision is one of the most closely watched in Canadian history, with an impact that will be felt both in Quebec and across the country. Reacting to the ruling on CBC, Prime Minister Mark Carney said his government would study its implications, adding it was important for all legislatures "to respect the rights and liberties of all Canadians, including those in the minority." The Supreme Court was asked to weigh in on a number of questions, including on the constitutionality of Bill 21, whether Quebec's use of the notwithstanding clause was appropriate, and whether there are limits to its use. On Friday, the top court confirmed the validity of Bill 21, but ruled that the law infringes on democratic rights by banning Quebec's elected officials from wearing a face covering for religious reasons. The court also ruled that a Canadian court has the power to declare whether a law is consistent with the Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms even if the notwithstanding clause is invoked, but that they would not do so in this case. While the majority of the seven justices found that Quebec's law is largely valid, some dissented to parts of the decision. Justices Andromache Karakatsanis, Michelle O'Bonsawin and Nicholas Kasirer wrote that the notwithstanding clause "cannot be used to authorize laws that are incompatible with the fundamental character of Canada as a free and democratic country". Specifically, they said they believe the law infringes on the charter's guarantee to freedom of religion, freedom of expression and the right to equality. Civil liberty groups in Quebec have criticised Bill 21, saying it disproportionately affects Muslim women who wear the hijab, arguing that it has excluded them from key areas of public life in the province.

articles.title: Marital rape: Millions of wives in South Asia unprotected - study
articles.summary: More than 100 countries have outlawed marital rape, but a large part of South Asia has not.
articles.body_text: Failure to fully criminalise marital rape leaves millions of women and girls unprotected in eight South Asian countries, where intimate partner violence is 35% higher than the global average, says a new study. More than 100 countries have outlawed marital rape, but a large part of South Asia - India, Afghanistan, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh - remain among the three dozen countries which haven't. The only South Asian country where rape within marriage attracts the same penalty as any other rape is The Maldives. Nepal and Bhutan have criminalised marital rape, but apply lesser penalties, says the study by Samaj, a coalition of women's rights groups in the region. South Asia's marital rape laws largely stem from British colonial rule, says Ranjeeta Silwal of Equality Now, a global women's rights group part of Samaj. The law, dating to 1860 in India and Bangladesh and 1885 in Sri Lanka, lists exceptions to rape - including sex by a man with his adult wife. Campaigners say the law is outdated and forced sex is rape, regardless of the perpetrator. Experts warn marital sexual violence harms women's physical, psychological, emotional and sexual well-being. More than 100 countries have criminalised marital rape, including the UK, which changed its law in 1991. But the exemption remains in India, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. Pakistan removed the marital rape exception in 2006, but no higher court has confirmed that rape laws apply within marriage. A recent high court ruling, meanwhile, granted husbands broad immunity for non-consensual sex. Since returning to power in 2021, the Taliban have steadily dismantled women's protections in Afghanistan. A new penal code introduced in January made matters worse, Silwal says. Under it, a husband can be prosecuted for violence against his wife only if he causes a broken bone, open wound or severe bruising. Even then, he faces just 15 days in prison if convicted. Unsurprisingly, the code makes no mention of marital rape. But its narrow definition of punishable violence effectively denies women protection against it.

articles.title: Zelensky tells BBC US too focused on Middle East and not pushing Russia hard enough
articles.summary: Ukraine's president voices frustration with US and says it is not pushing Russia hard enough in peace talks to end the war.
articles.body_text: Volodymyr Zelensky has voiced deep frustration with the US, criticising Donald Trump for calling Vladimir Putin "my friend" and saying delays in delivering vital anti-ballistic missiles were costing Ukrainian lives. In an interview with the BBC at his central Kyiv office, Ukraine's president complained the US was not pushing Russia hard enough in peace talks, and called it "strange" that Trump posted a photo of himself embracing Putin. "Of course it's up to the president of the United States, but... it's strange," Zelensky said, speaking in English. "He's an aggressor, and a killer... He can't be a friend. Just cannot be," he said, adding it was like saying you were friends with Adolf Hitler during World War Two. Since a bruising encounter with Trump in the Oval Office in 2025, Zelensky has been careful how he handles relations with the US. Trump's two envoys, Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, have been trying to negotiate a peace deal between Russia and Ukraine - to end the huge loss of life. But they often seem more in tune with Moscow's position, than that of Kyiv. Kushner, Trump's son-in-law, said on Wednesday that Putin had shown "restraint" by not using nuclear weapons in Ukraine. He also described Putin as a "grand master of politics". The latest round of peace talks in Abu Dhabi earlier this month made no obvious progress: "The more we know, the more problems", is how Zelensky described it. He said talks were expected to resume in December. On Thursday, Trump posted on his Truth Social platform that at his own summit with Putin in China last week he had urged Russia to "pull back all military aggression against territories throughout Europe" and said he believed a peace deal with Ukraine was "a strong possibility". But from its public statements, Russia appears to have regressed to its initial, hardline negotiating positions – on everything. And Zelensky revealed that it was not clear whether European negotiators would be at the table, as the US envoys had announced .

articles.title: Grupo de bomberos coinciden: “Por la noche lo recomendable es no cerrar la puerta con la llave puesta”
articles.summary: Grupo de bomberos coinciden: “Por la noche lo recomendable es no cerrar la puerta con la llave puesta”. Los bomberos explicaron por qué no es recomendable cerrar la puerta con llave y revelaron las razones técnicas detrás de esta advertencia. Todos los detalles, en esta nota.
articles.body_text: En muchas familias del mundo es habitual que las personas cierren la puerta de su vivienda con llave, con el objetivo de sentirse más seguros ante cualquier acto delictivo o simplemente por costumbre. De hecho, estudios psicológicos señalan que esta práctica genera una mayor sensación de control, reduce la ansiedad y la percepción de riesgo, y contribuye a proteger la privacidad y las pertenencias del hogar. En ese sentido, una advertencia de los bomberos ha llamado la atención de los internautas, ya que exhorta a evitar este hábito que podría poner en riesgo la seguridad del hogar. Ante ello, los especialistas recomendaron adoptar otras medidas sencillas que podrían ayudar a proteger la vida y prevenir posibles accidentes. En la siguiente nota te contamos todo lo que debes saber al respecto. De acuerdo con el Centro de Emergencias 112 de Castilla y León, recomiendan no cerrar con llave la puerta y dejarla puesta, sobre todo, durante la noche debido a que puede dificultar el acceso en una emergencia médica, ya sea en el caso de personas mayores que viven solas y sufren caídas o descompensaciones. Y es que, el principal inconveniente, según especialistas, es que la mayoría de las cerraduras impide abrir la puerta desde el exterior cuando la llave permanece colocada por dentro. Además, advierten que mantenerla girada de forma permanente puede acelerar el desgaste del mecanismo. De hecho, los bomberos indican que realizar este hábito no incrementa de manera significativa la seguridad, ya que una cerradura puede ser vulnerada con las herramientas adecuadas por los delincuentes. En tanto, los bomberos de Burgos también recomiendan mantener cerradas las puertas interiores sin cerrojo, ya que esta medida ayuda a contener un incendio, retrasa la propagación del fuego y facilita una evacuación o el acceso de los equipos de emergencia. Por ello, piden instalar cerraduras con pomo giratorio interior o antipánico, pues permiten asegurar la puerta desde el interior sin necesidad de usar la llave, conforme comparte OkDiario. A través de un artículo compartido por OkDiario, el ingeniero químico Diego Fernández recomendó que, para realizar una buena limpieza en el inodoro, es indispensable retirar primero la suciedad visible y realizar la desinfección después, cuando sea necesario. Por su parte, según los Centros para el Control y la Prevención de Enfermedades de Estados Unidos (CDC), el agua y el jabón o detergente permiten eliminar la mayoría de los gérmenes. Asimismo, aplicar lejía o desinfectante sobre superficies sucias puede reducir su eficacia debido a la presencia de materia orgánica. De esta manera, el profesional indicó que un método eficaz de limpieza comienza con la eliminación de la suciedad visible y la aplicación de un producto específico para el baño. Una vez enjuagados los residuos, se debe aplicar el desinfectante siguiendo las indicaciones del fabricante y respetar el tiempo de acción establecido en la etiqueta. Así, dejó en claro que una regla fundamental es no mezclar productos de limpieza, como lejía con otros desinfectantes, ya que pueden liberar gases peligrosos. Por ello, instó a mantener una buena ventilación y no aplicar lejía en el inodoro mientras queden restos de otros productos.

articles.body_text: Un helicóptero de la Fuerza Aérea del Perú (FAP) sufrió un accidente este 27 de noviembre mientras cumplía una misión de extracción de una patrulla militar en la región de Ayacucho. articles.title: El dólar cierra la semana en S/3,45 y suma tres jornadas consecutivas de pérdidas
articles.summary: La moneda estadounidense acumuló tres jornadas consecutivas de pérdidas, favoreciendo al sol peruano en un contexto de recuperación de los precios de los metales y una mayor oferta corporativa de dólares por los pagos de fin de mes.
articles.body_text: El precio del dólar cerró este viernes en S/3,455 en el mercado cambiario peruano, registrando una caída de 0,55% frente a los S/3,474 del cierre anterior y de 0,20% respecto a los S/3,462 de la apertura. La moneda estadounidense acumuló tres jornadas consecutivas de pérdidas, favoreciendo al sol peruano en un contexto de recuperación de los precios de los metales y una mayor oferta corporativa de dólares por los pagos de fin de mes. “El repunte del cobre y la mayor oferta de dólares por parte de las empresas durante el cierre de mes han contribuido al fortalecimiento del sol. Sin embargo, el dólar internacional se mantiene cerca de sus máximos de 22 meses, respaldado por la persistencia de la inflación en Estados Unidos y las expectativas de un nuevo incremento de tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal en diciembre”, explicó Jorge Luis Huayta, trader FX de Kambista. En los mercados internacionales, el Índice del Dólar Estadounidense (DXY) se mantuvo alrededor de los 103.80 puntos, mientras Wall Street consolida una recuperación semanal en una sesión bursátil reducida por el Black Friday. Por su parte, el cobre alcanzó los US$12,515 por tonelada, acompañado por avances en el oro y la plata, mientras el petróleo Brent se mantuvo alrededor de los US$97 por barril ante los riesgos geopolíticos en Oriente Medio. En el ámbito local, el Banco Central de Reserva (BCR) reportó un superávit comercial récord de US$12,202 millones durante el tercer trimestre, acumulando 25 trimestres consecutivos con resultados positivos. Asimismo, durante CADE Ejecutivos 2026 se destacó el crecimiento de 14.8% de la inversión privada entre enero y septiembre. No obstante, persisten los riesgos inflacionarios asociados al Fenómeno El Niño Costero, cuyo impacto llevó al Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF) a reducir su proyección de crecimiento para este año de 3,4% a 3,1%. De cara a la próxima semana, el análisis de Kambista señala que la atención estará centrada en los indicadores de actividad manufacturera de China, la inflación de noviembre en Perú y el reporte de empleo de Estados Unidos, previsto para el viernes 4 de diciembre. Una recuperación de la actividad industrial china podría favorecer al cobre y al sol peruano, mientras que cifras laborales estadounidenses superiores a las expectativas podrían reforzar las perspectivas de una política monetaria restrictiva de la Fed y generar nuevas presiones alcistas sobre el tipo de cambio.

articles.body_text: La Sociedad Peruana de Hidrocarburos (SPH) saludó la firma de la adenda al contrato de concesión con Cálidda, que permitirá ampliar la distribución de gas natural a siete regiones del centro y sur del Perú. El gremio destacó que este acuerdo representa un avance importante para la descentralización energética, al facilitar que más familias accedan a los beneficios económicos de este recurso. “Saludamos la firma de este acuerdo, que representa un paso importante para cerrar las brechas de acceso al gas natural en el país. Las familias del centro y sur del Perú merecen contar con una energía más económica y menos contaminante, en las mismas condiciones que Lima y Callao”, señaló Felipe Cantuarias, presidente de la SPH. La modificación contractual contempla una inversión privada de cerca de US$600 millones de para extender la distribución de gas natural a 15 ciudades de Cusco, Puno, Ayacucho, Junín, Apurímac, Ucayali y Huancavelica. En una primera etapa, se proyecta beneficiar cerca de 300 mil hogares, lo que representa aproximadamente 1.2 millones de peruanos. Uno de los principales beneficios del acuerdo será el acceso al gas natural en las mismas condiciones tarifarias que Lima y Callao, lo que permitirá generar importantes ahorros en la economía de los hogares. Asimismo, la disponibilidad de una energía más competitiva contribuirá a reducir los costos operativos de las micro y pequeñas empresas y del transporte, fortaleciendo la competitividad y dinamizando las economías regionales. Se estima además que el acuerdo generará más de 9 mil puestos de trabajo, entre directos e indirectos. “Este acuerdo demuestra que es posible avanzar en la masificación del gas natural con inversión privada y generar beneficios concretos para la población. La descentralización energética debe traducirse en menores gastos para las familias, mayor competitividad para las mypes y nuevas oportunidades de desarrollo para las regiones”, agregó Cantuarias. De acuerdo con los plazos previstos, las primeras conexiones se iniciarán entre 18 a 24 meses desde la firma de la adenda. Para la SPH, este avance debe contribuir a que el acceso al gas natural deje de concentrarse en determinadas zonas del país y llegue progresivamente a más peruanos.

articles.title: La vivienda y la inmigración: las preocupaciones que definirán el voto de los españoles
articles.summary: El presidente socialista Pedro Sánchez se somete nuevamente a las urnas para intentar, otra vez, mantenerse en el poder en unas elecciones que favorecen a sus rivales conservadores
articles.body_text: Maricarmen Abascal tenía 87 años. El 23 de setiembre la desalojaron del departamento que alquilaba y en el que había vivido con sus padres desde que tenía 17 años. Dos semanas después, murió en un hospital y se convirtió en símbolo de una de las preocupaciones más acuciantes de los españoles: el acceso a la vivienda. Luego de masivas protestas en Madrid, el jefe del Gobierno Español, Pedro Sánchez, decidió convocar a elecciones de manera anticipada. Como buen zorro político que es -por algo ha sobrevivido ocho años como presidente pese a la andanada de casos de corrupción que han sacudido su gobierno- decidió que era el momento para reafirmarse. La jugada puede salirle bien, como ya ha pasado antes, o puede terminar con él fuera del Palacio de la Moncloa. En el sistema parlamentario español no gobierna automáticamente el partido más votado, sino aquel candidato que logra reunir la mayoría necesaria en el Congreso de los Diputados. En la última legislatura, el PSOE (Partido Socialista Obrero Español) ha gobernado en coalición con la plataforma de izquierda Sumar, pero para sacar adelante la investidura y aprobar leyes ha dependido del apoyo parlamentario de formaciones nacionalistas e independentistas, como los partidos vascos y catalanes. El Partido Popular (PP), el clásico partido de centro-derecha, va primero en las encuestas (31,4% según el promedio de “El País”), pero no con demasiada ventaja respecto al PSOE (29,1%). Si gana los comicios, su líder, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, tendrá que pactar con la extrema derecha de VOX y su presidente, Santiago Abascal. Según los sondeos, VOX tiene un 18% de apoyo y ya se ha convertido en el tercer partido más importante de España. “La agenda de Vox ha influido muchísimo en el PP, pero también tiene que ver con la polarización que hay en España, en la que están contrapuestas la izquierda y la derecha. VOX y el PP tienen un mismo perfil de votante: un elector de derecha en lo económico y cultural, solo que VOX es una expresión más extrema de ello”, explica a El Comercio el politólogo español Javier Carbonell, director del think tank Future Policy Lab. Pedro Sánchez tomó uno de los temas más sensibles para los españoles para convertirlo en oportunidad política. Según una encuesta de YouGov, el 53% de los españoles sitúa a la vivienda como su principal preocupación, seguido de la inmigración con el 35%. La corrupción y el fraude suman 28% mientras el acceso a la salud es un 19%. La economía se sitúa en el quinto lugar con el 15%. “Sánchez convocó a las elecciones porque el tema de la vivienda moviliza a la izquierda pues sitúa el debate sobre el estado de bienestar. Para la izquierda, el gran problema es que está desmovilizada y Sánchez tiene que conseguir sacar a esos votantes, porque el país está muy polarizado. Acá no se trata de convencer a nadie del otro lado, sino precisamente en quién moviliza a los suyos”, señala Carbonell. Si bien antes de la tragedia de Maricarmen, el tema de la vivienda era de los más recurrentes por el aumento de los alquileres y los desahucios, luego de su muerte se convirtió en el centro del debate político durante la campaña electoral. Mientras el bloque de izquierda (PSOE y Frente Amplio) propone construir 100 mil viviendas sociales e intervenir el mercado con leyes que bajen las rentas, el PP apuesta por aumentar la oferta construyendo un millón de viviendas. VOX, en tanto, apoya la desregulación del mercado, pero también defiende que se dé preferencia a los españoles frente a los inmigrantes en la lista de espera para acceder a ‌una vivienda. “En estos años que Sánchez ha estado al frente del gobierno no ha podido resolver el gran problema de la vivienda. Pero tampoco lo va a poder resolver porque la población española, así como en muchas partes del mundo, está envejeciendo. Y acá viene el tema de la migración, pues mientras se reduce una población, la de los migrantes crece, entonces se vuelve un asunto muy complejo”, expresa a este Diario el analista Arturo Ponce Urquiza, docente de la Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México y de la Universidad Anahuac. Según explica Reuters, la normativa urbanística introducida tras el estallido de la burbuja inmobiliaria en el 2007 ha ralentizado la construcción y la ha encarecido. La CNMC, el organismo regulador de la competencia en España, estima que el proceso de transformar un terreno en una vivienda puede llevar entre 10 y 15 años. Sin embargo, el tema de la vivienda no ha sido el más conflictivo que Sánchez ha tenido que afrontar en esta corta campaña. “El gran tema ha sido, también, la gestión del Estado. Hace poco hubo un accidente de tren, que es el segundo en dos años, además de varias crisis, como apagones, riadas, inundaciones. Una serie de cosas que dan la impresión de que el Estado no está funcionando”, refiere Carbonell. El tema migratorio, como ocurre con todos los partidos de extrema derecha de Europa, ha sido crucial para VOX, y para esta campaña el asunto no quedó en un segundo plano, sobre todo tras la crisis de Ceuta ocurrida a fines de julio. Aquella vez, durante varios días, hasta 80 mil personas llegaron a nado desde Marruecos saltándose vallas hacia este enclave español ubicado en la costa norafricana. Abascal no ha tenido reparos en señalar que apoyará las expulsiones masivas de inmigrantes o la “remigración”, como prefiere llamarlo, señalando que este tema será una prioridad nacional. El PP, por su parte, aboga por endurecer el control fronterizo y ha planteado el despliegue de la Armada para contener flujos migratorios. Además de Ceuta, donde aún quedan unos 10 mil marroquíes (la mayoría fueron devueltos a su país), ambas campañas se han enfocado en lo que está pasando en las Islas Canarias, ubicada en el Atlántico frente a las costas africanas, y que está registrando cifras récord de embarcaciones precarias repletas de migrantes. En seis semanas han llegado más de 17 mil personas, casi el mismo número que en todo el año pasado (17.788). Pese a todos los cuestionamientos al gobierno de Sánchez, el socialista es experto en salir inmune y resucitar cuando todos los dan por muerto. Y esta vez, sus rivales pecarían de excesiva confianza si creen que ya le ganaron la partida. “Siempre es difícil apostar en contra de Pedro Sánchez a nivel político. Todos los que lo han hecho, han perdido. Veremos si en este caso pasa lo mismo, aunque el escenario es bastante complicado y sería bastante impresionante que logre mantenerse en el gobierno”, acota Carbonell, quien vaticina que, pese a las encuestas, el PSOE será la primera fuerza política. Habrá que esperar a los resultados del domingo para saber si Sánchez lograr revivir, una vez más.

articles.title: Helicóptero de la FAP se accidenta en Ayacucho: confirman ocho militares fallecidos y un sobreviviente
articles.summary: Un helicóptero de la Fuerza Aérea del Perú (FAP) sufrió un accidente este 27 de noviembre mientras cumplía una misión de extracción de una patrulla militar en la región de Ayacucho. El hecho se produjo en las inmediaciones de la localidad de Sanabamba, dentro del ámbito del Valle de los Ríos Apurímac, Ene y Mantaro (Vraem).
articles.body_text: Un helicóptero de la Fuerza Aérea del Perú (FAP) sufrió un accidente este 27 de noviembre mientras cumplía una misión de extracción de una patrulla militar en la región de Ayacucho. El hecho se produjo en las inmediaciones de la localidad de Sanabamba, dentro del ámbito del Valle de los Ríos Apurímac, Ene y Mantaro (Vraem). El siniestro fue confirmado mediante el Comunicado Oficial N° 004-2026-CEVRAEM, emitido por el Comando Especial Vraem. Información preliminar sitúa la ubicación del impacto en la zona de Canayre, provincia de Huanta, e indica que la unidad correspondería a un helicóptero modelo Mi-17. Las operaciones de búsqueda y rescate permitieron localizar la aeronave y a los nueve efectivos militares que se encontraban a bordo, según informó el Comando Especial VRAEM mediante el Comunicado Oficial N.° 005-2026-CE VRAEM, emitido este viernes 27 de noviembre. La institución confirmó el fallecimiento de ocho militares: cinco integrantes de la Fuerza Aérea del Perú (FAP) y tres del Ejército del Perú. El único sobreviviente es el comandante FAP Enzo Espinoza Roque, piloto del helicóptero, quien fue evacuado a Lima para recibir tratamiento médico especializado. Entre los fallecidos figuran el capitán FAP Bruno Rivas Zegarra y los suboficiales de primera Jorge Evanan Mendoza y Franklin Odar Yovera, así como los suboficiales de segunda Luis Alcántara Castillo y Marcos Palomino Ayme. También perdieron la vida los suboficiales del Ejército Segundo Pereira Huayambe, Carlos Huanilo Santamaria y Crisólogo Contreras Huamán. El Comando Especial VRAEM precisó que las circunstancias y causas del accidente son materia de investigación por parte de las autoridades competentes. Asimismo, expresó sus condolencias a los familiares de los militares fallecidos y aseguró que brindará apoyo y acompañamiento a sus seres queridos. El accidente se registró cinco días después de la entrada en vigencia de una prórroga al estado de emergencia decretado en la macrorregión. Mediante el Decreto Supremo Nº 152-2026-PCM, publicado el 20 de noviembre, el Poder Ejecutivo extendió la medida por 60 días calendario en 12 distritos y ocho centros poblados de Ayacucho, Huancavelica, Junín y Cusco. La normativa vigente mantiene la responsabilidad del control del orden interno en manos de las Fuerzas Armadas, con el respaldo operativo de la Policía Nacional del Perú. articles.summary: Un helicóptero de la Fuerza Aérea del Perú (FAP) sufrió un accidente este 27 de noviembre mientras cumplía una misión de extracción de una patrulla militar en la región de Ayacucho. El hecho se produjo en las inmediaciones de la localidad de Sanabamba, dentro del ámbito del Valle de los Ríos Apurímac, Ene y Mantaro (Vraem).
articles.body_text: Un helicóptero de la Fuerza Aérea del Perú (FAP) sufrió un accidente este 27 de noviembre mientras cumplía una misión de extracción de una patrulla militar en la región de Ayacucho. El hecho se produjo en las inmediaciones de la localidad de Sanabamba, dentro del ámbito del Valle de los Ríos Apurímac, Ene y Mantaro (Vraem). El siniestro fue confirmado mediante el Comunicado Oficial N° 004-2026-CEVRAEM, emitido por el Comando Especial Vraem. Información preliminar sitúa la ubicación del impacto en la zona de Canayre, provincia de Huanta, e indica que la unidad correspondería a un helicóptero modelo Mi-17. Las operaciones de búsqueda y rescate permitieron localizar la aeronave y a los nueve efectivos militares que se encontraban a bordo, según informó el Comando Especial VRAEM mediante el Comunicado Oficial N.° 005-2026-CE VRAEM, emitido este viernes 27 de noviembre. La institución confirmó el fallecimiento de ocho militares: cinco integrantes de la Fuerza Aérea del Perú (FAP) y tres del Ejército del Perú. El único sobreviviente es el comandante FAP Enzo Espinoza Roque, piloto del helicóptero, quien fue evacuado a Lima para recibir tratamiento médico especializado. Entre los fallecidos figuran el capitán FAP Bruno Rivas Zegarra y los suboficiales de primera Jorge Evanan Mendoza y Franklin Odar Yovera, así como los suboficiales de segunda Luis Alcántara Castillo y Marcos Palomino Ayme. También perdieron la vida los suboficiales del Ejército Segundo Pereira Huayambe, Carlos Huanilo Santamaria y Crisólogo Contreras Huamán. El Comando Especial VRAEM precisó que las circunstancias y causas del accidente son materia de investigación por parte de las autoridades competentes. Asimismo, expresó sus condolencias a los familiares de los militares fallecidos y aseguró que brindará apoyo y acompañamiento a sus seres queridos. El accidente se registró cinco días después de la entrada en vigencia de una prórroga al estado de emergencia decretado en la macrorregión. Mediante el Decreto Supremo Nº 152-2026-PCM, publicado el 20 de noviembre, el Poder Ejecutivo extendió la medida por 60 días calendario en 12 distritos y ocho centros poblados de Ayacucho, Huancavelica, Junín y Cusco. La normativa vigente mantiene la responsabilidad del control del orden interno en manos de las Fuerzas Armadas, con el respaldo operativo de la Policía Nacional del Perú. El despliegue de las fuerzas del orden se desarrolla en el marco de operaciones contra remanentes terroristas y el narcotráfico, resguardando además el eje energético del gas de Camisea que se extiende hasta el distrito de Anco.

articles.title: The tech products we enthusiastically recommend this holiday season | TechCrunch
articles.summary: We've been reviewing a bunch of new gadgets at TechCrunch this year, and we have some clear favorites to share for your Black Friday shopping and beyond.
articles.body_text: We’ve been reviewing a bunch of new gadgets and hardware at TechCrunch this year: dumb phones , bird feeders , health trackers , slushy machines , AI mattress pads , you name it. Sometimes we think they’re unnecessary and expensive , but other times, we try out devices that we love so much that we go out and buy them ourselves. If these products can impress a group of (sometimes) curmudgeonly tech reporters, then they’re sure to please whoever you’re shopping for this holiday season. We’ve updated this article with new Black Friday pricing for some of our recommendations. Black Friday deals are likely to end by the end of November 30 (Cyber Monday). We’ve reviewed a lot of e-readers this year. What can we say? We’re nerds. We work for a tech website. But after trying devices from the usual suspects as well as some wildcards, we have recommendations. Evidently, 2026 was the year we fell in love with the pocket-sized e-reader. It’s an e-reader so small that it can fit in your wallet, or even magnetize to the back of your phone. Do you dream of a world where instead of scrolling Instagram when you’re waiting in line for coffee, you actually opt to read books? There’s really something special about the Xteink X3 , and it’s only $55 during Xteink’s Black Friday sale . Fair warning, it takes some fiddling with to set up, and it has no integration with Kindle, Libby, or any other apps, so only buy this for someone willing to do a bit of Reddit browsing and tinkering to get it up and running. If you aren’t planning to magnetize the Xteink to your phone, you’ve got to go with the X4 Pro , which is also discounted for Black Friday . It’s slightly bigger, but it has a backlight, which makes it way more versatile. After using both the X3 and the X4 Pro , I find that the backlight really is a game changer, since I do a lot of reading in bed — plus, I like my Pop Socket wallet a bit too much to displace it for the X3, and I’d rather just carry an extra credit card-sized device than risk forgetting my actual credit and ID cards, which I have grown too used to having on my phone. If I’m being honest, reading my colleague Aisha Malik’s review of the Boox Palma Pro 2 is making me want to buy one. I love using the Xteink e-readers, but they don’t connect to any outside apps. As a hardcore Libby power user (a phrase I am saying in earnest sincerity), it’s a bit frustrating that I can’t get my library books on Xteink e-readers. The same goes for apps like Kobo and Kindle, where any e-book you already own cannot be transferred out of the Amazon ecosystem unless the publisher agrees, which most do not. If you’re looking for an e-reader with a screen that’s actually book-sized, my favorite that I’ve used is the Kobo Libra Colour , which is $259. The Amazon Paperwhite line is great, but c’mon, Amazon. Branch out! Hey, we’ve all got to eat. And if you want, you can make that eating process overly techy. Why not? The Ember Mug 3 is the latest iteration in Ember’s line of coffee/tea cups that actually stay warm. Our reviewer Lauren Forristal especially appreciated that you no longer need to use your phone app to change the mug’s temperature, which seems like it would be really annoying! This mug is perfect for gifting to someone, or to put on your own wish list — you might not want to spend $99 (or $94 right now for Black Friday ) on a mug for yourself, but these sorts of luxury, nice-to-haves are what holidays are made for! Ah, Ninja, the premiere company in the business of turning every appliance into a two-in-one air fryer. I jest, but at least Ninja knows it’s on to something. Despite the Ninja Crispi Microwave and Air Fryer ‘s high price point, Lauren says that this new product made “a pretty convincing case for ditching two appliances and making room for one.” You can’t buy more counter space (without moving), but you can buy more versatile appliances. There’s a $100 off Black Friday deal here .

articles.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.
articles.body_text: Nvidia is under pressure to do things differently, and a new WSJ report shows how far that’s going. According to the Journal, Nvidia has told manufacturing partners, including Dell and Super Micro, to hit pause on server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia for an unspecified period as it assesses whether its regional partners are meeting U.S. export requirements. As for why those countries, Chinese companies have been tapping Nvidia chips remotely from data centers there, a loophole the US Commerce Department closed — reportedly grudgingly — earlier this month. The Journal notes that the think tank Institute for Progress estimates remote data centers like these supply about 24% of China’s AI computing power. articles.title: Is Alice Huang a spy or not? | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The central, still-unproven claim in the Nvidia scandal is that Alice Huang, the former Megaspeed exec with whom Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair, is a Chinese spy.
articles.body_text: The central, still-unproven claim in the Nvidia scandal is that Alice Huang, a former executive at the data-center company Megaspeed, is a Chinese spy. She had an affair with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who abruptly resigned on Nov. 12 after acknowledging it and was just as abruptly reinstated on Monday of this week. What’s publicly known is murkier than the headlines suggest. U.S. intelligence has reportedly tracked Alice Huang’s contact with an officer of China’s spy agency, but officials haven’t offered public evidence that she was commissioned to target Nvidia’s chief. In the past week, after President Trump successfully pushed to bring Jensen Huang back, the administration has played down the allegations it once circulated internally. Whether that reflects new intelligence or political pressure is the big question. Undisputed reporting shows the claim emerged from the White House itself . It first appeared in a highly classified memo written in March under the oversight of Secretary of State Marco Rubio and circulated to White House officials ahead of Trump’s trip to China in May. The memo formed the partial basis for the New York Times’ initial reporting on the scandal, published Oct. 29 and its existence was first reported on Nov. 8 . The memo did not definitively say, according to the Wall Street Journal, that Alice Huang was a Chinese spy. CNN, by contrast, has reported that the memo concluded she was a Chinese intelligence asset. What’s better established is that Alice Huang was in touch with Chinese intelligence. The Ministry of State Security (MSS) is Beijing’s civilian spy agency, responsible for both foreign intelligence and domestic counterintelligence. Last weekend, the Times, citing people with knowledge of U.S. intelligence reports, reported that Huang was in contact with an MSS officer from the spring of 2025 until this fall , a period that overlaps her relationship with Jensen Huang. (The Chinese government has called the spy claims a “smear,” and Megaspeed says Huang left the company in August 2025 and that its business is legitimate.) Attorney General Todd Blanche, who was Trump’s personal defense lawyer before taking over the Justice Department, told journalists on Tuesday: “I have no reason to stand up here and say Nvidia is anything but a good corporate citizen.” On the same day, Trump said a pardon was an option for Jensen Huang but that he did not think one would be needed. Senior intelligence officials reportedly told Congress that the government apparently has no actual evidence that the MSS directed Alice Huang to pursue an affair with Jensen Huang. None of those statements necessarily exonerates Alice Huang as an intelligence agent. Instead, they support the alternate theory that the Chinese government didn’t tell her to begin the affair and that Jensen Huang broke no law by having it. From a certain angle, the circumstantial evidence surrounding Alice Huang looks quite suspicious. She was a top executive at a company investigated for illicitly channeling Nvidia chips to China, and her husband, Kang Wei, is said to have even closer ties to the MSS, with some sources saying he worked for the agency. The timing of the government’s reversal is at the heart of the matter. Trump has said he lobbied the board “directly and indirectly” to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, so it wouldn’t be surprising if officials who serve at his pleasure were recasting the case in terms that satisfy his agenda. That wouldn’t necessarily make their assessments wrong. But unless new intelligence has actually resolved the question, and none has been publicly identified as yet, that backdrop is critical to keep in mind. CBS has also reported that Rubio has privately voiced concerns about aspects of Jensen Huang’s return. Earlier this month, CNN reported that the intelligence community was still working to understand Alice Huang’s relationship with Jensen Huang and that the intelligence collected on her to date does not prove she was acting as a spy for Beijing. After a briefing by top intelligence officials earlier this month, Rep. Jim Himes (D-Conn.), the incoming chair of the House Intelligence Committee, said he was unsure whether she was a spy or a “ useful idiot .” And this week, the Wall Street Journal pointed out that under Chinese leader Xi Jinping, top corporate executives routinely maintain ties to the country’s intelligence service without being formally deputized as assets. The crush of conflicting claims, most from anonymous government sources, obviously leaves large questions unanswered as to what actually transpired. Some of those questions that naturally spring to mind: There are answers to all of these questions, of course, but when the public will get them is anybody’s guess. Jensen Huang is due to appear before the Senate Banking Committee next week, and by the look from the statements of some of its members , he’s likely in for a rough ride. Unfortunately, congressional hearings, particularly public ones, rarely unearth secrets that haven’t already been disclosed.

articles.title: X finally gets parental controls after 20 years | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Elon Musk's social network X has finally added parental controls for teenagers, giving parents and guardians a way to manage what their kids see on the platform.
articles.body_text: After 20 years of existence, X, the social network formerly known as Twitter, has finally added parental controls for teenagers, giving parents and guardians a way to manage what their kids see and interact with on the platform. But unlike most platforms’ implementation of such controls, X is putting its own spin on the system by giving teens a say in the matter. The company said accounts belonging to 13-to-17-year-olds will be set to “protected mode” by default, meaning they won’t be able to see sensitive content, and won’t be served targeted ads. However, X is allowing teenagers to retain a measure of control over their accounts, letting them see what restrictions were made to their accounts. Parents and guardians will also not be able to read their teens’ private messages, see search or viewing history, or post as their teen. The controls let parents see how much time their teen spends on X per week, set daily limits, require their approval for new followers, limit feed recommendations and videos to already followed accounts, filter specific words, turn off sensitive media, specify who can send their teen DMs, and see who they are messaging. The controls arrive months after X came under fire for a lack of controls preventing the platform’s AI chatbot from being used to generate sexualized images of children and women . The social network has also long been rife with child sexual abuse material , misinformation , AI bots, and openly lets users post porn . X has generally not been a platform aimed at teenagers, but that doesn’t mean they don’t use the platform. A 2024 study found that nearly a third of Gen Alpha kids have an X account. The platform itself requires users to be at least 13 years old, though that’s not a high bar given the kind of content on the platform. “Parents want practical tools, and teens deserve room to grow. With Parental Controls on X, families can set the guardrails that fit their home, while teens keep ownership of their accounts and can see every change. Striking that balance is vital and what we set out to build.” Michael O’Herlihy, head of safety at X, wrote in a blog post. articles.title: A month with the iPhone Duo has changed how I use my phone | TechCrunch
articles.summary: From reading more books to breaking mindless scrolling habits, Apple's foldable has changed my daily routines in ways I didn't anticipate.
articles.body_text: For years, the definition of a premium smartphone depended on its cameras, processors, and how light it felt when you stowed it in your pocket. The iPhone Duo challenges that concept by asking consumers to pay more for a fundamentally different smartphone experience, even if it means sacrificing what they’ve long thought of as high-end features. In a little under a month of using the Duo, I’ve found that the trade-offs I was initially concerned about matter far less to me than I had expected. What’s been more interesting is how the Duo’s foldable form factor has changed my everyday habits, including how I interact with apps, which apps I use, and how I organize and personalize the phone itself. I also easily forgot a number of my initial concerns about switching to the Duo. The apps, for the most part, are now optimized for the Duo; I’ve reacquainted myself with Touch ID; and I don’t miss the Pro Max camera on most days. That’s not to say the Duo doesn’t have its shortcomings. I still miss that telephoto lens sometimes, and I’m still longing for Face ID — though not as much since Apple shipped a face unlock feature in the latest update. But after a month of using the Duo, I’ve found these compromises have had less of an impact on my day-to-day experience compared with the benefits that the new form factor brings. I was surprised by how much I’ve grown to appreciate the Duo’s multitasking capabilities. Initially, I didn’t think I’d regularly use it to view two apps side by side, given the still fairly limited screen space even while the phone is unfolded, especially compared with an iPad. But I’ve found myself snapping apps to both halves of the screen more often than I had imagined. For starters, Apple has made this side-by-side mode incredibly intuitive and easy to use — you simply drag the app over to the left or right side of the screen and drop it into the target box that appears. I have regularly taken advantage of this feature to do all sorts of things. I really enjoy keeping X open as I read through the news, which allows me to switch back and forth between the article I’m reading and real-time reactions to it. Sometimes I’ll keep email or Slack open on the side while I’m working on something else so I don’t miss an important message or notification. And much like the overstimulated members of Gen Z (which I am not), I sometimes like scrolling social media while engaging with some other media off to the side. Case in point: I passively watched Netflix’s “Love is Blind” reunion while reading the gossipy tweets and Reddit posts about the main characters on the other side of the screen. This sort of TV watching behavior used to be called second-screen viewing , but now it’s morphing into something new. Everything is happening on one screen, so should we call it “Duo screen viewing,” perhaps? It makes me long for even more interactive TV experiences where commentary and content are combined. I’ve noticed another shift in my behavior since adopting the Duo as my main device. When I’m out and about, the Duo feels more like an (arguably heavier) iPhone mini . For those who still miss smaller iPhones, the Duo is the next best thing. Despite its weight, the phone feels small. You can cover it with one hand; you can type with a thumb; you can reach the top and bottom easily; and you can even fit it into your front and back pockets. The Pro Max now feels unbelievably strange in my hand — how was I ever comfortable wrangling this giant rectangle? The Duo’s small screen works well when you’re on the go, especially for short interactions like responding to a quick text or pulling up directions to a destination. It’s not as great for mindless scrolling, which I appreciate, as it forces me to engage with the real world instead of killing every moment of boredom or unease by opening up apps.

articles.title: Grand Theft Auto VI proves why efficiency isn't a virtue | TechCrunch
articles.summary: On the same day that Anthropic entered the public market, a painstakingly human video game became one of most successful entertainment launches of all time.
articles.body_text: It should have been impossible for “Grand Theft Auto VI” (GTA VI) to live up to the hype. Fans waited 13 years for the newest installment in the crime-adventure franchise, and Rockstar Games exceeded even those inconceivable expectations when the game finally came out last week. GTA VI launched as the highest-rated game of all time on Metacritic and made $3.79 billion on release day to mark what could be the biggest entertainment event ever – more massive than “Avengers: Endgame” ( $2.9 billion ) or Taylor Swift’s Eras tour ( $2 billion ). The 13-year wait certainly fueled the frenzy, and sales, around GTA VI, but some fans craved GTA VI because of what it represents in the emerging era of AI. Even the biggest workaholics among us – startup founders – scheduled time off to play the game, including Spiry co-founder Dima Beseda , who told TechCrunch, “I reshuffled my workload to free up time around the weekends and even booked vitamin IV drips to keep my energy up.” Yet some players felt a sense of anticipatory nostalgia as they wiped away a layer of dust on their Xbox to play the game they’d been looking forward to since they were kids. “We do have a view that GTA is likely to be the last game of its kind to be made this way,” Ben Feder , managing partner at TIRTA Ventures and former CEO of Rockstar parent company Take-Two Interactive, told TechCrunch. That’s because GTA VI was created entirely without generative AI . “We’re kind of at this technological moment where this way of developing has sort of reached its natural frontier,” Feder said. “I don’t think you can say that games like this will always be around.” As millions of people immersed themselves in Vice City, the tech industry witnessed another long-awaited moment: Anthropic became the first major AI lab to go public. At Nasdaq HQ, Anthropic executives gathered to celebrate the Claude maker’s $81.3 billion IPO. At virtually the same moment that Anthropic broke the record for the largest IPO ever, GTA VI was also breaking records with the highest-rated and best-selling game launch of all time. But when the Anthropic team rang the bell on Thursday, the sound also signaled the end of an era in video game development, and perhaps even in the arts at large. The AI industry operates with efficiency as its north star. The promise of this technology is that we will be able to automate so much work that we can expand the capabilities of humanity, avoiding needless time spent tinkering with ultimately fruitless ideas. Instead, a prompt goes into an LLM, and a response is spat out. This technological revolution exploded into the world with some soul-crushing side effects: children are inundated with mind-numbing slop on YouTube, lawyers cite nonexistent cases in court, and tech companies like Meta lay off tens of thousands of people as part of a corporate-branded “ Year of Efficiency. ” But against the backdrop of the AI industry’s first major IPO, Rockstar has unveiled a game that about 5,000 people labored over for more than a decade.

articles.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan to put AI data centers in space | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The FCC dismissed some of the key concerns raised by opponents, including potential threats to scientific research, because the agency determined they fell outside its regulatory authority.
articles.body_text: SpaceX was given conditional approval by the Federal Communications Commission on Wednesday to deploy and operate a constellation of up to 1 million satellites for its orbital data center business, a regulatory victory for Elon Musk and his bid to move AI data centers into space. The FCC authorization was granted despite objections from Amazon, Viasat, and the American Astronomical Society, which flagged concerns over orbital debris and congestion, radiofrequency interference, and environmental consequences. Amazon, which is building a competitor to SpaceX’s Starlink service, argued in its petition that the application lacked basic details and described it as a “lofty ambition rather than a real plan.” Despite that lack of detail, Amazon also said the proposal “risks real harm.” The FCC dismissed some of the key concerns raised by opponents, including potential threats to scientific research, because the agency determined they fell outside its regulatory authority. FCC Chair Brendan Carr said in a statement that the action “opens a bold new frontier for the computing infrastructure needed to power America’s leadership and growth.” Musk thanked Carr in a post on X , writing “Much appreciate. This will be a great asset to America and the world.” This initial regulatory approval doesn’t mean orbital data centers are imminent. SpaceX faces a number of technical and economic challenges, including how to dramatically reduce the cost of manufacturing and launching satellites, cool processors in space, and even how to secure financing for chips that are destined for orbit. The company must also clear other regulatory hurdles. The FCC has not yet approved SpaceX’s plans to handle orbital debris for satellites that would operate above 600 kilometers, for instance. SpaceX requested a waiver of existing FCC rules, which requires satellites ending missions below 2,000 kilometers reenter Earth’s atmosphere within five years of completing those missions. The company is interested in moving some of these retired satellites into other orbits around Earth or even around the sun, according to the FCC authorization document . SpaceX has said it plans to deploy the satellites, known as Starmind, at altitudes ranging from 500 to 1,002 kilometers. The FCC’s approval gives SpaceX the authority to use radiofrequency communications to maintain contact with and control its orbital data centers from Earth if their primary communications systems fail. The Starmind satellites would primarily communicate using lasers to connect with other satellites, including SpaceX’s Starlink. The FCC has given SpaceX time to sort out these issues. Under the approval, SpaceX has seven years to get its first operational satellite into orbit and 14 years to deploy the entire constellation.
